entries.role: A clean feasible goal: no critic flag, accepted first time.
entries.goal_text: Maximise profit and on-time delivery together, counting each 0.01 of on-time delivery as worth £5,000.

entries.role: The critic acted: it swapped plans, and the plan is still flagged as not robustly feasible.
entries.goal_text: Maximise profit while keeping unplanned failures to at most one over the month.

entries.role: An infeasible goal: no plan meets the constraints; closest-achievable options.
entries.goal_text: Maximise profit with on-time delivery of at least 99% and a stockout probability of no more than 1%.

entries.role: No room: the only lever cannot move the objective, so nothing is recommended.
entries.goal_text: Maximise profit by changing only the preventive-maintenance interval of M5.

entries.role: Ambiguous wording with one reasonable reading.
entries.goal_text: Squeeze more money out of the line, but don't let more than about a quarter of days end in a stockout.

entries.role: A constraint on unplanned failures, a weakly predicted KPI; also flagged as novel.
entries.goal_text: Maximise OEE with no more than 1.5 unplanned failures expected.

entries.role: Lower cost per unit with an on-time delivery floor (the cost card).
entries.goal_text: Get the cost per unit as low as possible while still delivering at least 80% of orders on time.

entries.role: Lower downtime with a profit floor: the closest to the breakdowns card.
entries.goal_text: Minimise machine downtime while keeping profit at £200,000 or more.
